title: A finite family of covectors separates k-vectors
statement: For all P, k ∈ ℕ there are L ∈ ℕ and k-covectors b_1,…,b_L on ℝ^P (continuous alternating k-linear forms) with the following property. If w, w' are k-vectors (continuous linear functionals on k-covectors, `NVector`) and w(b_l) = w'(b_l) for all l, then w = w'.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ), ∃ (L : ℕ) (b : Fin L → Covector (Eucl P) k), ∀ w w' : NVector (Eucl P) k, (∀ l, w (b l) = w' (b l)) → w = w'
